name: qingyi
description: Enhanced /qingyi:project-init command, reusable skills (commit, commit-push, debug, Excel, Sentry, merge-worktree, merge-worktree-no-commit, fetch-notion-tasks, obsidian-init, remove-deadcode, rewrite-history, setup-permission).

excel_runner.title: Excel runner
excel_runner.description: Command prefix for running Python scripts in the Excel skills, e.g. python, uv run python, conda run -n Excel python. openpyxl must be installed in that environment.

log_paths.title: Production log paths
log_paths.description: Production log directories or files that the debug-code skill checks during production-scope debugging. Absolute paths or paths relative to the project root.
